datasets.label: Blender Synthetic (NeRF)
datasets.description: Dataset NeRF Blender com 8 cenas sinteticas (lego, hotdog, chair, etc). Usado em NeRF e D-NeRF.
datasets.paper: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields (Mildenhall et al., 2020)

datasets.label: D-NeRF Dynamic Dataset
datasets.description: Dataset de cenas dinamicas com metadados temporais. Usado em D-NeRF e metodos dinamicos.
datasets.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'D-NeRF dataset: baixe manualmente em https://www.albertpumarola.com/research/D-NeRF/index.html e extraia em ./data/d_nerf'"
datasets.paper: D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes (Pumarola et al., 2021)

datasets.label: Mip-NeRF 360 (cenas reais unbounded)
datasets.description: Cenas de escala real 360 graus (garden, room, counter, kitchen, bonsai, bicycle, stump). Alta qualidade para benchmarks avancados.
datasets.paper: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields (Barron et al., 2022)

datasets.label: Tanks and Temples (grande escala)
datasets.description: Cenas de grande escala com groundtruth 3D (truck, train, playground, etc). Referencia para avaliacao de reconstrucao.
datasets.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'Tanks and Temples: registre em https://www.tanksandtemples.org/download/ e baixe manualmente para ./data/tanks_and_temples'"
datasets.paper: Tanks and Temples: Benchmarking Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction (Knapitsch et al., 2017)

methods.label: NeRF Static (bmild/nerf)
methods.description: Implementacao original do NeRF em TensorFlow. Referencia classica para cenas estaticas.
methods.paper: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields (Mildenhall et al., 2020)

methods.label: D-NeRF (albertpumarola/D-NeRF)
methods.description: D-NeRF para cenas dinamicas com campo de deformacao temporal em PyTorch.
methods.paper: D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes (Pumarola et al., 2021)

methods.label: 3D Gaussian Splatting
methods.description: Renderizacao em tempo real por splatting de gaussianas 3D. Muito mais rapido que NeRF.
methods.paper: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering (Kerbl et al., 2023)

methods.label: 4D Gaussian Splatting
methods.description: Extensao do 3DGS para cenas dinamicas usando gaussianas 4D (espaco-tempo).
methods.paper: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering (Wu et al., 2024)

notes: Catalogo preparado para download automatico e manual.
Para Linux/Mac, substitua os comandos PowerShell por: curl -L <url> -o arquivo.zip && unzip arquivo.zip
Mip-NeRF 360 e Tanks&Temples sao datasets grandes (7-15 GB). Com GPU A100 ou RTX 3090, resultados sao melhores.
D-NeRF e Tanks&Temples requerem registro/download manual nas paginas oficiais.
Use 'nvs-benchmark install --only datasets' para instalar todos os datasets configurados.
